summary: Retest of the iteration_295 fixes. Backend: 22/23 pytest pass (15 regression tests from iter295 plus 8 new ones). The one failure is a new gap: GET /api/bfpo/ppm/services/{id} does not return the sign-off. Frontend: fixes 1-5 are confirmed. For fix 6, the MOD job recap is fixed, but the completed MOD PPM service shows a contradictory 'No customer signature captured.' Fix 7 is confirmed via the API (exactly one signature row after completion, none on a 400, the retry is blocked). Regression of the case drawer Details report, the Maintenance Calendar visit report and the asset-list PDF passes.
verified_fixes: (1) Part row layout: on desktop 1920 the name input is 702px and qty is 80px; on mobile 390 the name is 196px and qty is 80px. Typed part names are readable.

(2) Locked Complete tab (svc engineer job): EngineerReportView shows the signature inside the report (report-view-signature, 'Signed by …'), or 'Customer unable to sign — reason'. complete-locked-signature is hidden and there is no 'No customer signature captured' text.

(3) end == start is rejected: backend 400 'End time must be after the start time' on the svc job, the MOD job and MOD PPM (no PPM signature inserted). The frontend shows report-time-error when end == start. A one-minute report returns 200.
(4) Single-site customer-equipment includes site_id '' machines (in site A, site B and all). The 'All sites' option shows no count.

(5) All sites > Log case: mixed sites, unassigned + site, and unassigned-only all show the 'Pick machines from one site to log a case' toast with no modal. Two site-A machines open the intake with Demo Head Office preselected.
(6a) MOD engineer History > completed job: jobdetail-completed-recap shows engineer-report-view with the signature ('Signed by TEST_ MOD Signer').
(7) PPM complete: 1 svc_signatures row after success; a second complete returns 400 and the row count stays 1; a 400 on equal times inserts 0 rows.

minor.issue: The response has no signoff/signature field, though the complete endpoint stores one in svc_signatures (ppm_service_id). PPMServiceDetail therefore cannot show the captured sign-off. Fix: in get_service, add svc['signoff'] = await db.svc_signatures.find_one({'ppm_service_id': service_id, 'organization_id': BFPO_ORG_ID}, {'_id': 0}, sort=[('signed_at', -1)]).

ui_bugs.issue: A completed PPM service renders <EngineerReportView report={svc.engineer_report} /> without signoff, so it always says 'No customer signature captured.' even though sign-off is mandatory for PPM completion. This is the same contradiction fixed in (2), now on the MOD PPM screen. Pass signoff={svc.signoff} once the backend returns it.

design_issues.screen: Service Desk Equipment > Log case toast
issues: The hint 'Unassigned machines need a site first.' also shows when the selection simply spans two real sites, where it doesn't apply. Minor.
Per-site labels say 'Demo Head Office · 14 machines', but the single-site list now shows 21 (14 plus 7 unassigned). The counts don't match what's listed. Low priority.
A closed visit still shows the 'ALLOCATED' stage badge above the engineer report (carried over from iter295).

action_items: Return the PPM sign-off from GET /api/bfpo/ppm/services/{id} and pass it as signoff to EngineerReportView in PPMServiceDetail. Today it always shows 'No customer signature captured.'
Optional: show the 'Unassigned machines need a site first' hint only when an unassigned machine is in the selection
Optional: align the per-site machine counts with the list (which now includes unassigned machines)
critical_code_review_comments: bfpo_ppm.complete_service: record_generated_document (cert auto-file) still runs before the signature insert and status update, so a failure in svc_signatures.insert_one or update_one would leave a filed certificate document for an uncompleted service. This is low risk (both are simple writes).

The completed PPM check is status-based; two concurrent completes could both pass the 'already completed' check and insert two signatures (no atomic guard). Consider find_one_and_update with status != completed before the side effects.
